digest.component_or_area: bridge pause/resume surface and gate format migration
propositions: Pause and resume surface must preserve dual-format gate blob with both new keys (paused, reason, who, paused_at) and legacy gated_mode for rollback safety and old-reader compatibility
New pause operation must block before lock acquisition or ticket mutation, return rc 0 with stable anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker, and be recognized by scheduled workflow to skip commit-and-push

Pause provenance must enforce repository git user.email identity and RFC3339 first-pause timestamp; same-reason re-pause is idempotent and preserves metadata; different-reason and CAS-conflict cases refuse without overwrite
Resume operation must delete only observed ref OID via CAS and safely recover corrupt blobs without decoding; corrupt state returns clean rc 1 recovery marker without traceback
Legacy reconcile-check early return and old rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary must remain functional with unchanged behavior
Workflow, CLI help, user guide, and exit-code documentation must expose pause/resume surface without including unshipped features like --until or automatic expiry
